lead_profile_text: Existing property looking for higher return
property_situation: Owner-occupier in Portugal for a 1-year architecture contract; cash buy, no mortgage; property otherwise empty
primary_blocker: Keys are with him in Portugal; office room to clear; wants guarantees ('rigid')
language_signals: No point keeping the house empty
You can consider this particular property as test match
People promise hundreds of things, but they don't really keep their promises
I'm not hungry and greedy, but of course I need money
if I make like 60, 70 grand, I'm more than happy to go for retirement

delay_signals.trigger_phrase: I got all set of key with me now... we have to wait a little bit
delay_signals.timeline_given: Post keys by recorded next-day delivery; ~3 weeks to live after keys

green_light_signals.trigger_phrase: before I come back... start signing contracts
green_light_signals.context: Wants to sign before UK trip in ~2 weeks

meeting_flow.pivot_to_business: I would just pull up the figures
meeting_flow.income_intro: gross revenue of about £44,300... about £23,000 of net revenue... £1,900 a month
meeting_flow.how_it_works_transition: I'll give you an overview of... guest communication, listing on multiple platforms, pricing, cleaning, key management
meeting_flow.pre_close_setup: Remote onboarding: sign, post keys, ~3 weeks to live
meeting_flow.meeting_2_ask: I'll send it via email and WhatsApp

lead_responses.what_lead_said: As long as I know whatever you're promising me... is rigid and you're guaranteeing me that, I'm more than happy
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Pretty confident within 6 months; within 10-15% accuracy; profitable on all 3 cases
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: I can commit for a year

lead_responses.what_lead_said: How will you charge fees and how do I get paid?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Monthly payout 1st-5th; PDF statement on the 1st

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Can I transform my residential property to a business property?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Suggested limited company + company let (INCORRECT per intelligence entry; corrected in email)
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Of course I have no idea about it

lead_responses.what_lead_said: one bedroom is my office... can't list as 1-bed
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Must be 2 bedrooms; recommend sofa bed
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Do you advise me to change couch for a sofa bed?

conversion_gaps.gap: Wants guarantees of what is promised
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Re-state no earnings guarantee but firm service commitments in agreement/action plan
Recorded next-day post; key safe link

positive_shift_moments.what_caused_shift: No mortgage = profitable in worst, likely and best case

positive_shift_moments.lead_response: That is a very good idea

friction_moments.what_caused_friction: Business-rates claim ('that would qualify... should be zero') was wrong
friction_moments.lead_response: Of course I have no idea about it

opening_phrases: I thought I'd start just by understanding a bit on your current situation and situation with the property, and then we can go through the figures and our service if it lines up with what you're looking for.
reassurance_phrases: from a risk standpoint, I would say this is pretty low
zac_language.objection_handling_pattern: Reassure with no-mortgage; practical next steps

profile_psychology_intersection.recommended_meeting_adjustment: For cash-owning ABROAD leads with a portfolio plan, secure signature before their UK trip and make an offer when keys/access are resolved.
